common_criteria.requirement: Edit canonical sources and regenerate; never patch dist directly.
Render ES, EN and PT for Persona and Empresa without fallback or cloned audience copy.
Each resource has one shell, one main and explicit module, order, resource, locale and audience identity.
IDs are unique and every local href, aria-controls, aria-labelledby and aria-describedby reference resolves.
Sibling navigation preserves module, locale and audience and exposes one visually distinct current resource.
Breadcrumbs, canonicals, hreflang, sidebar and deep links resolve without changing the resource context.
No essential content depends on JavaScript; keyboard, focus, reduced motion, print, 200 percent zoom and AA remain usable.
Two isolated builds are byte-identical and bind source, renderer, CSS, JavaScript, PDF and output hashes.
Maximum state is RENDERED_DRAFT with no publication, tracking, network dependency or extra storage key.

masterclass.requirement: The governed local PDF is the primary surface and appears before sibling navigation and the accessible HTML guide.
Previous and next controls retain a visible icon or label at 320 and 390 pixels in light and dark themes.

workbook.requirement: Exactly three localized stages render in order: in-class, deepening and consolidation.
Consolidation contains criterion, expected evidence, review timing, transfer and a three-level rubric.
The hero follows the approved two-column grammar and its outcome watermark matches the current module order.
Five localized milestones lead into an ephemeral case intake and explicit prerequisites, inputs and limits.
Exactly three preparation prompts expose receives, produces and a resolvable library reference.
Every stage keeps dense guidance in accessible disclosures and the workbook closes with the next resource.

playbook.requirement: A primary start action reaches intro from the hero and is visible in the first viewport at 320, 390 and 1440 pixels.
The complete index has no broken target and every chapter closes with an observable decision, action or evidence handoff.

prompts.requirement: Each prompt exposes Chat or Sources, N1 through N4, Template and Demo, inputs, parameters and Receives to Produces.
Demo is fully resolved and synthetic; missing prior outputs or real-world execution are explicit gates, never invented evidence.
The graph has no orphan transition, undeclared cycle, implicit external execution or unresolved next artifact.

editorial_criteria.requirement: Language is natural and localized; specialized English terms are introduced once with a plain-language equivalent.
Persona and Empresa differ in actor, decision, evidence, risk and transfer rather than by a suffix.
Depth comes from useful decisions, examples and limits; visible density stays at or below twice the approved baseline.
